summary.intent: Run load tests against the staging API with 10/20/30 clients to establish baselines, then scale up to find the capacity limit of a single instance, and analyze where the uploadFile latency is spent.
summary.outcome: Baselines captured for 10/20/30/100 clients with zero errors; two CI workflow bugs were fixed (Vitest flag, missing environment declaration, scenario filter, timeout); Prometheus analysis identified Kubo IPFS pinning as the dominant bottleneck (~95% of upload latency, ~1.73s per pin, 3 pins per uploadFile); results documented in the baselines file; 50/75-client runs queued to fill the scaling curve.

repo: The load-test workflow uses GitHub environment 'staging' for secrets (STAGING_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET, STAGING_API_URL) — jobs must declare `environment: staging` or those vars are empty.
SDK uploadFile makes 5 sequential API calls: 3x POST /ipfs/upload (ciphertext, file metadata, folder metadata) + POST /ipns/publish-batch + POST /ipns/publish.
Kubo IPFS pinning accounts for ~95% of upload endpoint latency (mean 1.73s per pin), with 3 pins per uploadFile making it the dominant bottleneck.
IPNS publish is fast (mean ~141ms) — it's a DB upsert only; DHT propagation is async and fire-and-forget with 0.26% error rate.
Baselines are stored in .planning/baselines/ following the pattern 19-someguy-ipns-baselines.md; a phase-18 file exists for format reference.
A 'docs/phase-19-baselines' branch is used for accumulating baseline documentation.
Throughput scales sub-linearly at high concurrency: 5.4x throughput at 10x clients (10→100), with upload p50 doubling from 2.6s to 5.1s but zero errors throughout.
The 'SDK E2E Tests' required check was missing from branch protection on main after a CI consolidation; 'Verify E2E Passed' is a separate job that should not be modified.

code.finding: Original workflow used `pnpm test:single -- <scenario>` which passes args after `--` into CAC's separate bucket, not vitest's file filter — all 5 scenarios ran instead of the selected one. Fixed by calling `pnpm exec vitest run --no-coverage <scenario>` directly.
Job timeout was 30 minutes — insufficient when scenario filter was broken and all 5 scenarios ran. Bumped to 60 minutes after fixing the filter.
The test:single script used --testPathPattern which is a Jest flag, not valid in Vitest.

workflow: Running multiple `gh run watch` instances simultaneously (6 watchers at 3s poll interval = ~120 req/min) will hit GitHub API rate limits quickly; use a single status check instead.
GitHub Actions jobs referencing an environment show as 'Deploying to <env>' in the UI — this is cosmetic only, no actual deployment occurs.
Commit messages should use `chore(ci):` prefix to prevent release-please from triggering a version bump for CI-only changes.
Load tests hitting the same staging API should use a concurrency group to queue runs sequentially and avoid interference between concurrent runs.

friction: First three load test runs failed immediately due to two bugs: --testPathPattern (Jest flag in Vitest) and missing environment: staging causing empty secret vars.
Scenario filter bug caused all 5 scenarios to run instead of just the selected one, making runs take 16+ minutes and causing 50/75/100-client runs to hit the 30-minute job timeout and get cancelled.
Running 6 concurrent `gh run watch` instances burned through the GitHub API rate limit; multiple check attempts failed for ~1 hour.
`gh run watch` exited early on some runs due to the deployment environment approval step, creating confusion about whether runs had completed.
Background task watchers returned stale exit-0 results from earlier completed runs, creating confusion about which notifications were real.
User had to interrupt the assistant twice when it appeared stuck (once at the start, once during result formatting).
open_items: 50 and 75-client load test runs are queued but not yet complete — results need to be retrieved and added to the baselines doc to fill in the scaling curve.
The Prometheus analysis should be added to the baselines doc once 50/75 results are in.
Potential optimization: Kubo pinning is the bottleneck — investigate faster storage backend, pin batching, or concurrent pins to improve upload latency.
0.26% async DHT propagation error rate noted — worth monitoring but not blocking.
The scenario filter fix (PR #340) was merged but the 100-client run was triggered before it was merged and still passed — worth verifying the filter is working correctly in the 50/75 runs.
